_doc: The render tool converts declarative code (Mermaid, D2, TikZ, etc.) or natural language prompts into professional images. It supports dark/light themes and multiple formats.
_code_note: Direct code rendering is faster and cheaper (0.001 credits).
_prompt_note: If code is null, you can provide a natural language description. The agent will use an LLM to generate the diagram (0.01 credits).
